summary: A two-storey wood-frame house built in 1962 on a quarter-acre lot. Owner: Jane Q. Sample. The assessor's sketch shows a 10.4 m by 8.2 m outline; a rear deck was permitted in 2014.

facts.note: The 2019 listing, listed by Sam Agentman, 555-123-4567.

footprint.shape_note: A simple rectangle; the deck is outside it.

permits.work: Re-roof, asphalt shingles. Contractor: Bob Roofer & Sons.
Kitchen remodel: wall between kitchen and dining room removed. Applicant: John Doe
New rear deck, 3.6 m by 4.8 m.
New back fence and a garden shed.

history.text: Built as part of a small post-war subdivision (plat recorded 1961).

sources.title: Testville County Assessor, parcel record
sources.said: Built 1962, 1,450 sq ft, 2 floors, 3 bedrooms, building sketch 34 ft x 27 ft. Owner of record: Jane Q. Sample.

sources.title: Testville permit portal
sources.said: Three permits: 1988 re-roof, 2009 kitchen remodel, 2014 deck.

sources.title: 2019 listing (archived copy)
sources.said: 3 bed, 1.5 bath, 1,520 sq ft, updated kitchen, deck. Contact agent@example.org.

sources.title: Testville GIS parcel and plat map
sources.said: Lot 0.25 acre, house set back 7 m from the street.

blocked.what: The permit drawings for the 2014 deck (as a PDF)
